buttons.label: Open doors
buttons.script: for (const castle of objects.getAll('castle')) { if (castle.definition.id === 'entrance-castle') castle.testEntranceOpenAmount = 1; }

buttons.label: Close doors
buttons.script: for (const castle of objects.getAll('castle')) { if (castle.definition.id === 'entrance-castle') castle.testEntranceOpenAmount = 0; }

buttons.label: Bell startle
buttons.script: const puff = [...objects].find(o => o.definition?.id === 'frost-puff-primary'); puff.onBellRung({eventId: Symbol('test-bell'), source: objects.getOne('hero'), duration: 3});

buttons.label: Throw (Ammo)
buttons.script: const puff = [...objects].find(o => o.definition?.id === 'frost-puff-primary'); puff.launch({velocity: {x: 1.5, y: 4, z: 0}});
